mechanism: Wider HY-IG credit spreads signal rising default risk and tightening financial conditions — historically bearish for equities. Spread compression indicates risk appetite recovery and is bullish for SPY. The spread leads equity drawdowns because credit markets price in distress before equity mark-to-market catches up.
caveats: FRED ICE BofA OAS series (BAMLH0A0HYM2, BAMLC0A0CM) are restricted to 3 years of history per FRED licensing terms effective April 2026. The requested 1997-present sample is unachievable through current API access. Delivered sample covers 2023-06-30 to 2026-04-30 (35 monthly observations). This is a PARTIAL DELIVERY.
Stationarity tests on 35 observations have low power. Results are indicative only — full-sample tests pending resolution of the sourcing constraint.
No approved proxy was used — data_sources_hy_ig_spy_v4_20260512.csv specifies no acceptable proxies for HY OAS or IG OAS.
SPY daily adjusted close is available for the full 1997-present window from Yahoo Finance. The credit spread data is the binding constraint on the aligned dataset.
